summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Patton Kizzire Withdraws
items.text: Patton Kizzire withdrew from the 3M Open after a 6-over 77 first round due to a back injury, continuing a pattern of recent withdrawals from key PGA Tour events.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Addresses Penalty and LIV UK Start
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau responded to his two-shot penalty at the Open Championship by saying he's moving past it, and opened LIV UK with an 8-under 63, aiming for a weekend duel with leader Lucas Herbert.
